about: Share the world you would like to build before you build it

We would be delighted to hear your idea. Sketching it here first lets us offer guidance before you invest the build time.

**Who or what would this experience honor?**

Every SceneXP experience celebrates a person, place, or business.

**What would visitors see and do?**

The scene, the mood, and any interactions or small delights you have in mind.

**Anything you would like guidance on?**

The shared parts library, the passive camera pattern, mobile performance, anything at all.
